intro: Score goals to unleash powers in this over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game.
description:
Pro Jank Footy is an absurd and over-the-top arcade sports game.

Score a goal? Your opponent picks a game-changing power-up.

Hinder your opponents, increase your footy abilities with powers that give your team strong legs, or turn the gameplay completely on its head by transforming everyone into footballs – the choice is yours!

Outplay, out-kick, and out-jank your mates in local multiplayer. Or, if you’re shy, conquer single-player season mode.

AUSTRALIAN RULES FOOTBALL LIKE YOU'VE NEVER SEEN IT

Australian Footy is the most attended domestic sports league in the world! 36 players on a field, an obscenely large oval, and a ball that looks like a sunburnt lemon...

For those outside the loop, “Aussie Rules” could mean anything. Pro Jank Footy takes this confusion and runs with it—a fast-paced, comedic sports game where you're constantly changing the rules.

WORLD-CLASS COMEDY

With commentating from Aunty Donna's Broden Kelly and the creative minds of David Ashby and Dario Russo behind cult TV series Danger 5 and Italian Spiderman driving the humor, Pro Jank Footy is jam-packed with comedy, charm and Australianisms.

FEATURES

ROGUELITE GAMEPLAY – Every goal scored lets your opponent choose from over 150+ ridiculous power-ups that completely alter the match. Or, play classic mode for simple, arcade footy with no power-ups. 

VERSUS MODES – Face off against AI or challenge your mates.

SEASON MODE – Lead your team through a full season with deck-building mechanics to unlock and customize power-ups as you progress.

RETRO ARCADE NOSTALGIA – Inspired by classic 90s sports games, blending pixel-perfect action with buttery-smooth modern gameplay.

UNIQUELY AUSTRALIAN – Aussie Rules meets Aussie humor. It’s chaotic, unpredictable, and proudly embraces Australian culture.

MULTIPLE TEAMS & STADIUMS – Play as 11 unique teams across 4 iconic stadiums, each with their own quirks, hazards, and surprises.
